output.reason: The evidence states that “Gold loans shall be governed by the Gold Loan Operational Guidelines of the Bank, which shall be read with this Policy” (para 4.5). It also directs that for loans/advances where the specific pre-payment cases do not apply, “pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB” (para 261(5)). It further requires that applicability/otherwise of pre-payment charges be “clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement” (para 261(8)), and that where a Key Facts Statement (KFS) is to be provided, the same shall be mentioned in the KFS (paragraph following 261(8)); additionally, “No pre-payment charges which have not been disclosed… shall be charged” (last 261 text).
